Drill 1: Gymnast does multiple glide swings into a spotted kip
Drill 2: Glide Baskets: Gymnast performs a normal glide swing, then pull both legs into a tight compressed pike in front of the bar and hold for min. 3 sec

Drill 1: Banded candlestick: Gymnast put feet in a band attached to bar behind them (On P-Bars) and start in a pike position then drag their legs up the bar into a candlestick shape
Drill 2: Trampoline bounces: A mini tramp is placed behind the gymnast just below the bar. Gymnasts start in dish shape on the bar and drop back onto their bottom on the trampoline and bounce back into their dish shape.
Equipment: Resistance band and Mini Tramp (small boxes if necessary)

Drill 1: Band Assisted Tap swings: With a resistance band attached to the low bar, gymnasts put their feet in the band and go between a Dish and Scoop shape.
Drill 2: Coach Assisted Strapped Swings: Gymnasts use straps attached to a metal bar and practice long swings while coach manually fixes shapes.

Drill 1: Sliding Back handspring: Using a big box placed on top of a wedge to create a downward slope, gymnasts lay with their head toward the floor and slide into a handstand shape then snap their feet to the floor into a front support shape
Drill 2: Use a large octagon to guide gymnats though the motion of a back handspring. a roundoff can then be added before the octagon once confidence is built

Drill 1: Using two small Octagons, gymnast falls over the first octagon into a handstand and immediately drives heels into a handstand to land on back on the next octagon to land standing up straight.
Drill 2: Handstand pop from scatter mat onto floor and fall onto a wedge landing in an dish shape with back off the wedge.
Equipment: 2x small octagons, scatter mat and wedge

Drill 1: Handstand Shoulder shrugs against the wall
Drill 2: Handstand pop onto a scatter mat

Drill 1: Place a small box at the end of the beam, Gymnast will cartwheel with hands hands on the box and land on the beam. Then they will do a cartwheel with their hands on the beam and land feet on the small box
Drill 2: Gymnasts use a line on the floor to practice cartwheeling in a straight line.
Equipment: Small Box and line on floor

Problem: Not getting up to a full handstand
Drill 1: Placing a Big box at the end of the low beam, Gymnasts place feet on the box, hands on the beam and switch between lifting legs up into a Half-handstand shape
Drill 2: Using a wedge at the end of a beam, Gymnasts will hold their handstand shape with their hands on the beam and their tummy to the wedge. They will then turn around and hold a Dish shape on the wedge so only their back is touching the wedge.

Drill 1: Gymnast will stand facing a beam in line with their hips with their foot on the beam. They will lift their leg off the beam and hold for a minimum of 5 seconds and repeat 3 times. This can then be repeated for the gymnasts back leg.
Drill 2: Gymnasts will start on the floor on their knees, then jump into a lunge position and lift their front leg of their leap so it is in line with their hips. They then repeat this 8-10 times.

Drill 1: Place a wegde in front of the crashmats and gymnasts perform their normal vault over the wedge.
Drill 2: Using a box, Gymnasts willplay on their tummy with their hips at the edge of the box. Staying in a tight shape gymnasts fall onto their hands and drive their heels into a handstand shape then fall flat onto a wedge.

Drill 1: Handstand Pop onto a scatter mat
Drill 2: Handstand pop onto a beat board into immediate pop onto floor to land in handstand against wedge
